### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in `rar2fs.c` are related to improving error handling and ensuring memory management. The addition of freeing `last_arch` prevents potential memory leaks when an error occurs while opening or reading the archive. 
- The change in the conditional check for file types before calling `get_vformat` enhances the robustness of the function by ensuring that it only processes valid file types, thus preventing unnecessary function calls and potential errors.
- Overall, these changes work together to enhance the reliability and stability of the volume consistency check functionality introduced in a previous commit.
